name: dispatcher-integration-testing-pattern
description: Integration tests for dispatcher native task store: use mkdtempSync for isolated Postgres DBs, mock getProjectByPath to return registered project (since path lookup depends on exact temp dir), mock spawnAgent to prevent process spawning. Exclude race condition tests that require mocking claimTask directly (covered by unit tests).

Resuming a stuck/failed run lost the workflow: resumeRuns→resumeAgent spawned the worker with a stub seed {id,title} and no workflowName/seedType, so the resumed worker re-resolved the workflow by a missing task type and ran the wrong (often minimax) pipeline. Fresh dispatch threaded workflowName correctly; only resume was broken.
resolution: resumeRuns now accepts a --workflow override, recovers the seed's type/labels via seeds.show, resolves via resolveWorkflowName (override precedence), and threads workflowName+seedType/labels/priority through resumeAgent to spawnWorkerProcess. Regression test: dispatcher-resume-workflow.test.ts.
